matchups.preview: Rilind's about to learn that auto-drafting at 2 AM while drunk is a life choice with consequences, whereas Rob's somehow managed to assemble a roster that looks competent despite his track record of panic trades at 11:59 PM on Sundays. This is gonna be ugly for one of you, and Rilind's got that "I don't know who half my players are" energy that screams Week 1 catastrophe.

Jetmir and Peter are about to learn what it feels like when a preseason powerhouse actually has to play meaningful football—Adam's coming in hungry and you two are trotting out whatever half-baked strategy you cooked up over beers last month. This is where the real teams separate from the draft-day disasters, and spoiler alert: you're about to get exposed.

Ilir's bringing a team held together with duct tape and prayer while Rinor probably overthought his entire draft strategy and ended up with three injury-prone RBs anyway -- either way, somebody's walking away from this bloodbath realizing their season is already cooked before it even started. May the fantasy gods have mercy on whichever one of you fuckers gets exposed first.

Faton's about to learn why his draft strategy of "just pick random Albanian names" isn't the fantasy football genius he thinks it is, while Flamur shows up with a roster that looks like it was assembled during a blackout. Two teams, zero wins, and absolutely zero excuse for how badly they're both about to fuck this up.

Veton's rolling into Week 1 with the same energy as someone who thinks "gut feeling" is a legitimate draft strategy, while Arben's over here acting like he just discovered that running backs actually matter. Two teams built on vibes and prayer about to learn that autopick works just fine without them—buckle up for the most confidently incompetent matchup of the season.

Ben's out here acting like drafting three wide receivers in the first four rounds is a "strategy" instead of a cry for help, while Nori's banking on a handcuff nobody's heard of to carry him to glory. This Week 1 matchup is basically watching two dudes who learned fantasy football from Reddit comments go full retard in real time—one of you is about to get humbled by the fantasy gods, and honestly, it's a coin flip which version of incompetence gets exposed first.
